##### Project general facts

Muraba Residences is an exclusive boutique residential development on the Eastern Crescent of Palm Jumeirah, offering just 46 apartments and four exceptional penthouses. Fully designed by the 2017 Pritzker Prize-winning Spanish architecture studio RCR Arquitectes, it is the only residential building in Dubai created entirely by Pritzker laureates. The project embodies a philosophy of timeless architecture, where natural light, open spaces, and uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline define every residence. Thoughtfully oriented from east to west, each home features private balconies that capture both sunrise and sunset, creating a seamless connection between indoor living and the surrounding landscape.

Residents enjoy an exclusive collection of wellness amenities, including a panoramic swimming pool overlooking the Arabian Gulf, a fully equipped fitness center, a Vitality Pool, Crystal Steam Rooms, Experience Showers, and spa facilities designed exclusively for homeowners. Every space has been carefully planned to promote relaxation, privacy, and a balanced lifestyle while maintaining the project's distinctive architectural vision.

Each residence is finished to the highest standards using premium natural materials, including marble flooring, Corian kitchen and bathroom countertops, and bespoke kitchens and bathrooms by Valcucine. Kitchens are fully equipped with Gaggenau appliances, including a refrigerator, oven, induction cooktop, extractor hood, dishwasher, and washing machine. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, with an optional furniture package available for purchase, allowing owners to personalize their living spaces while preserving the project's refined architectural character.

##### Location description and benefits 

Palm Jumeirah, an iconic man-made island in Dubai, is known for its unique palm-tree-shaped design and offers an exclusive lifestyle at the very heart of the Arabian Gulf. It features a combination of luxury villas, apartments, and hotels, making it one of Dubai's most prestigious residential and tourist destinations. With its private beaches, ocean views, and proximity to Dubai Marina, the island attracts those seeking a refined coastal lifestyle in an extraordinary architectural setting.

The area is renowned for its luxurious hospitality options, hosting some of Dubai’s most celebrated hotels and resorts, such as Atlantis The Palm and One&Only. These resorts add to the island's vibrancy with world-class dining, leisure, and entertainment venues that attract visitors and residents alike. Residents benefit from premium amenities, including private beach access, fitness centers, pools, and retail outlets, creating a comprehensive, self-contained living experience.

Palm Jumeirah’s location provides easy access to other major Dubai neighborhoods while maintaining a serene, resort-like environment. The island’s monorail and well-planned road networks facilitate movement within and beyond the island, connecting residents to the vibrant city. This combination of exclusivity, convenience, and scenic beauty makes Palm Jumeirah one of Dubai’s most desirable and well-rounded neighborhoods, offering a lifestyle that feels worlds away yet is intimately connected to the pulse of the city.
